Are you weary of your ordinary life?
Do you desire a moment bathed in the warm glow of the spotlight?
Dear friend, we have heard your voice!

Now, Starmaker Agency will roll out the red carpet just for you...

We cordially invite you to subscribe to the "Immersive Superstar Experience Service"
Here, fame goes beyond just 15 minutes!

Starmaker Agency firmly believes in "creating fame for those who have none."
We are dedicated to shattering the 15-minute rule, turning 15 minutes of fame into another 15 minutes again and again!

Starmaker Agency offers the following tiered dream-fulfillment packages:

Lite Experience | 1-Day Celebrity Experience | 88,000 Credits Only

Exclusive Styling Team: Carries out your head-to-toe transformation into a star

Hype Squad: Supports in-person yelling and hype atmosphere at designated locations, but upholds a strict zero tolerance policy against toxic fans

Public Opinion Simulation Team:
50 genuine alt-accounts to slide into your DMs
50 genuine alt-accounts to DM you hate messages
4 clickbait accounts to create highlight reels from promotional videos
* All videos and messages will be deleted upon service conclusion


Full Immersion | 3-Day Celebrity Experience | 888,000 Credits Only
(Includes Lite Experience package content)

Hype Squad: Provides a hype atmosphere at three locations, including airports and hotels

Public Opinion Simulation:
150 genuine alt-accounts to slide into your DMs
50 genuine alt-accounts to DM you hate messages
13 clickbait accounts to create highlight reels from promotional videos
* May opt to extend maintenance for an additional two weeks upon service conclusion

Personal On-the-Go Photography: Captures your most iconic shots
* This service includes 3 complimentary sample photos, and each additional photo costs 800 credits


Ultimate Customization | 7-Day Dazzling Stardom Experience | 1,888,000 Credits Only
(Includes Full Immersion package content)

Custom Celebrity Itinerary: Recording studio and film set experience opportunities

Hype Squad: Follows you around, creating a hype atmosphere wherever you go

Public Opinion Simulation:
2,000 genuine alt-accounts to slide into your DMs
188 genuine alt-accounts to DM you hate messages
28 clickbait accounts to create highlight reels from promotional videos
2 condensed personal interview videos
* May opt to extend maintenance for an additional three months upon service conclusion

Personal On-the-Go Photography: Captures your most iconic shots
* This service includes 10 complimentary sample photos, and each additional photo costs 800 credits

...

To make a reservation immediately, please contact: ██████████
P.S. We are recruiting extras at 800/day.
If you're interested, reach out through the above contact. We look forward to having you on board.

The contact number has been erased. Looks like this service was severely sanctioned by the Astropolis Network Administration.
